name: Soroe Clinic
description: Soroe Clinic is a calm block theme for orthodontic practices that treat teenagers and adults. The home page opens on a pale framed cell with one tall rounded photograph at the left, the headline beside it and a single hand-drawn thread line that crosses the photo edge and the headline, then a logo-row of four service marks. It continues with notice rows, the worries people arrive with, a slate band where three photographs step down the page with pale numerals hung across their corners, a parallax review-visit band, one example course in figures, staggered patient notes, a full-width fee table, a team list and first-visit steps. Instrument Sans and Figtree, high-key documentary photography, quiet scroll effects.
